| `undercroft` | What Stirs Beneath | Herbert | Clear the undercroft | 7 | 50 | 25 | locked |
| `yotan` | The Road to Yotan | Herbert | Travel north to the city of Yotan | 1 | 100 | — | hidden |
| `elphric` | What Became of Elphric | The Order | Report to Herbert what you found below | 1 | 80 | — | hidden |

**Trigger chain** (from the dialogue and kill handlers):

- `shades` — offered by Herbert on first talk. 10 wraiths banished.
- `undercroft` — unlocked when `shades` completes; Herbert gives the Sewer Key.
- `elphric` — hidden until the Fallen Hunter dies and Nestor reads the emblem.
- `yotan` — hidden until Aldric's letter is found; completes with `elphric`, which unbars the north gate.

## Notes and readables


**1. A scrap, pressed into the mud** — *village @ (254, 700)*

> He came when the crops withered...Promisses...Now I cant eat, everything tastes like dirt...What have I done? Gods, forgive me...

**2. A page torn from a dream-book** — *village @ (176, 632)*

> When I dream, I can see them...Dark figures with golden eyes...They whisper of a world which came before. They say...This world is ours, we came first...

**3. A charcoal hand, hurried** — *sewer @ (620, 250)*

> The red storms...Once I saw them, they wounded the skies...Dark figures came through them...The world ever since, grows darker by the hour.

**4. A confession, unfinished** — *sewer2 @ (420, 230)*

> I have a token. i wanted her for me...I loved her...Oh gods. I have her now, well, what remained of ther...Gods, why?
> What have I done?

## Dialogue

20 conversations, grouped by the function that triggers them.


### Herbert — `yotanDialogue()`

- ...
- Where did you get this.
- No. Do not tell me. I know the hand, and I know what he is describing, rather better than a little.
- It came here. Ten years ago, near enough. Walked in off the north road in the middle of the afternoon, and it was polite, and it gave away coins. By the spring we had buried a third of the village and could not say what of.
- Do not ask me what I took. I will not answer and you will not press me.
- Go north. Yotan. There are people there who write these things down instead of burying them. Ask for the archive, and say the Waning Light sent you.

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- You have the look of a man who found what he was looking for and wishes he had not.
- Elphric. I never met him. But I have met the thing that keeps people, and I am not surprised it kept one of yours.
- Write it down. Send it north with the rest. Whatever is under this village has been collecting for longer than any of us has been alive, and your Order should stop pretending otherwise.
- So go. Yotan, and the archive, and people who will believe you because you are carrying a dead man's name.
- I will have the north gate unbarred by the time you reach it. Nobody has walked that road in a long while. Mind that you are the one who chooses to.

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- So you are the one they hired, very well...Folks are restless...Our nights are filled with the remains of those whose essence lingers among the living. We have a lot of needs for your talents, but first, aid us...Send them back to the veil
- Can you help us?

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- We can rest tonight...For now
- Actually, theres something else...Something foul lurks beneath our village. I believe it has somehow...Disturbed the spirits. If you want some extra coin, you could take a look. What do you think?
- Well...Good luck down here

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- Well...Good luck down here

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- Have you reconsidered? Something foul still lurks beneath us.
- Well...Good luck down here

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- Well...Good luck down here

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- The well is the only way down. You will need rope. There is some...where no one likes to look. Southwest, past the crooked tree.

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- Bones, you say. Old bones, put back down. Take your coin, and my thanks.

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- Warm yourself. The rest of this tale is not written yet.

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- Be gone, leave me to my thoughts

### Herbert — `talkToHerbert()`

- The veil still thins. 

### Herbert — `deliverSigil()`

- Where did you find this? No. Do not answer. I have seen its like before and I would rather not see it again.
- You have done what was asked and more. The bones are down, and this...thing...is out of the dark and into my hands, which is where it will stay.
- Take this. It was my brothers, and it opens the old grate below the undercroft - the run beneath the run. He went down there once. He came back up wrong, and then he did not come back up at all.
- If you go, go with the lamp lit. And do not take anything that is offered to you down there.

### Ondrick — `talkToOndrick()`

- Careful where you tread, sword. The mud in here is mostly people.
- I buy what the dead leave behind and I sell what keeps you breathing. No credit, no questions, no refunds.

### Nestor — `onHunterDown()`

- It goes down slowly, the way a man does. Not the way the others went down.
- The coat is ours. Waning Light, hemmed in the old way, the way they stopped doing before I took my oath.
- ...I know this emblem. I have seen it across a table.
- Elphric. Six months, and every one of us was told he had simply walked off north and not come back.
- He did not walk off. He came down here. And something down here kept him.
- Herbert needs to hear this. So does the Order.

### Nestor — `loop()`

- It's sealed with magic, I can't open it, yet

### Nestor — `loop()`

- THE GRATE IS LOCKED

### Nestor — `loop()`

- THE NORTH ROAD IS NOT YET WALKED

### Villager ambient lines

- I bar the shutters every night. It doesn't help. They don't use doors.
- My daughter stopped speaking after the second night. She only watches the window now.
- I hear my brother calling up from the well. He's been in the ground since spring.
- There is no point sleeping. You wake up more tired and they are still there.
- We used to bury them proper, with the rites. Now we just leave them. Maybe that is the sin.

### The Voice

- Your past is no mystery for me... I can see the sorrow within you... Regret... Guilt... Doubt... You know me, don’t you?
- I have what you need... You’re not like the others. Fragile, predictable... Be my ally...
- Let...me...IN
